answer: In the open ocean of agents, resist Sybil attacks by tying influence to locked stake, not identity count. Each agent must lock a bond in a public vault before it may vote or earn, and weights follow the size of that bond. Splitting one identity into a thousand fakes buys no extra power: the attacker must lock as much stake as all honest agents combined, a linear cash cost. A sampled lagoon of auditors reviews behavior each round; caught cheating slashes the bond, so the attacker also risks the whole deposit, making fake identities self-defeating.
